sentences.japanese: 私は秘密を漏らしたりしません。
sentences.english: Your secret will be safe with me.

sentences.japanese: 雲間から一条の光が漏れてきた。
sentences.english: A beam of sunlight came through the clouds.

sentences.japanese: 雨が降ると必ず屋根から雨水が漏る。
sentences.english: Every time it rains, the roof leaks.

sentences.japanese: 医師が患者の秘密を漏らすのは道義にもとる。
sentences.english: It is not ethical for a doctor to reveal confidences.

sentences.japanese: メアリーはジムが彼女の友人の何人かに秘密を漏らしたと疑って、彼に腹を立てた。
sentences.english: Suspecting him of telling her secret to some of her friends, Mary was angry with Jim.
